presentation.label: FINE TUNE + SAMPLE RATE
presentation.summary: TUN turns in cents, press and turn for semitones; FIN's knob is RATE, pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse, on every sound.
presentation.overview: Fine Tune + Sample Rate gives a sample's pitch and speed finer control on the SAMPLE page. TUN turns 1 cent a step, faster as you spin it; press and turn for whole semitones, which keep the cents. The value reads with two places, as LFO depth does: +3.07, +3.00. The cents are kept in TUN itself, so a saved sound plays the same pitch on stock OS, which only shows the whole number. FIN's knob is RATE on every sound, a pure speed control: +63 plays at normal speed, 0 stops, -64 plays backward at normal speed, in a straight line between them, as the Octatrack's RATE with its setting on PTCH. Stock's pitch stops at a quarter of the speed. A trig below 0 starts from END. RATE starts at +63 on a new or cleared sound; a sound saved with FIN at +0 (stock's default, and every sound saved before 0.3.0) loads stopped: turn RATE up to +63.
highlights: Tune a sample in cents: turn TUN, press and turn for semitones.
Fine tuning saves in the sound itself and plays the same on stock OS.
Slow a sample to a dead stop and run it backward from FIN's knob, now RATE on every sound.
Exactly the Octatrack's range: +63 is 1x, 0 stops, -64 is -1x.
RATE is the name everywhere: the knob, the header and the LFO destinations.
Works beside LOP PIPO from Pipo Loop, without needing it.
usage: Press SMPL and turn TUN slowly: it moves 1 cent a step and reads +0.01, +0.02. Spin it faster to cover more ground.
Press TUN's knob and turn: whole semitones, the cents kept.
Put a long sample on a track, with LOP ON, and set RATE (FIN's knob) to +63. Play the pad and turn RATE down: the sample slows like a stopping turntable and rests at 0.
Keep turning below 0: it runs backward, smoothly through the stop. A new trig now starts from END.

access.location: SAMPLE page: TUN (encoder A) for fine tuning, RATE (encoder B, FIN's knob) for speed.
steps: Select a track whose sound plays a sample, and press SMPL.
Turn encoder A (TUN) for cents; press and turn it for semitones.
Turn encoder B (RATE): +63 is normal speed, 0 stops, below 0 plays backward.

controls.name: TUN
controls.doc: SAMPLE page, encoder A. -24.00 to +24.00 semitones. A plain turn moves 1 cent a step, with acceleration; press and turn moves whole semitones and keeps the cents. FUNC + turn jumps -24, 0, +24 as stock. Held trigs' locks take cents the same way. The value reads with two places, as LFO depth: +3.07, +3.00, and (0) at zero.

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: SAMPLE page, encoder B (FIN's knob), on every sound. +63 to -64: speed scales by |RATE| / 64, backward below 0, and +63 is exactly 1x. Starts at +63 on a new or cleared sound. TUN still multiplies it. Locks, LFOs and MIDI CC 25 reach it.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.7.

Run on a unit by the author as SP03 to SP13 (0.1.x) and by the author's automated rig (0.2.0 and 0.3.0, TESTING.md). Two voices together, performance and scene locks and sound browser load are from rytm-emu or not run there.

A sound saved with FIN at +0 (stock's default, and every sound saved before 0.3.0 without SMP RATE) loads with RATE 0: the sample does not play until RATE is turned up. On stock OS a sound saved with RATE +63 plays about a semitone sharp (FIN as a detune).
MIDI CC 24 sets TUN in whole semitones and clears its cents, as stock's CC does; NRPN keeps them to 1/128 semitone.
Other screens (LFO destinations, a sound lock's list) and stock OS show TUN as a whole number.
A pattern with TUN locks in cents saves one more lock lane per track, of stock's 72; stock OS loads those locks with their cents.
RATE never goes above 1x by itself; TUN does, to stock's ceiling of about 4x.
With LOP OFF, once the sample has played out, changing RATE does not bring it back: trig again.
A change of direction on a looping voice waits until it is 32 frames clear of STA and END; a trig does not wait.
Sound locks, scene locks and performance locks on RATE have not been run.

claims: param:FIN (id 40) is RATE: its names read RATE and its default is +63
param:TUN (id 39) turn and value text: fine in cents

load.display: Near nothing while no track's RATE is below 0; with one below 0, as 0.1.0 (about 0.8 % idle, measured)
load.conditions: Measured on an Analog Rytm MKII with a private telemetry base, sequencer stopped: removing 0.1.0 from the author's 16-module set lowered the idle block from 72.9 % to 72.1 %. 0.1.0's block handler walked all eight voices every block; 0.1.1 returns at once when no track has RATE on and no voice is still going down. The two gates in the step loop stay, about 10 instructions a voice; with RATE on, the handler and gates run as in 0.1.0. 0.3.0: the handler returns at once when no track's RATE is below 0 and no voice is still going down; the step-loop gates run on every voice (about 10 instructions each). Not measured for 0.3.0.

hardware.summary: 0.2.0 (this source) ran on npp1993's Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, as test image SF08 booted from RAM over USB (flash untouched), driven by the author's automated test rig with the author's go: 6 cases, all passing in two runs in a row (the earlier SF06, without the two-place text, passed three). Measured on the unit: plain turns of TUN move 1 cent a step, as many steps as stock's semitones (TUN words 0x400a, 0x3ffa, 0x4000); press and turn moves whole semitones keeping the cents (0x420a, 0x410a); FUNC + turn still jumps to +24 (0x5800); CC 24 clears the cents; a held trig's lock reads +0.05; screens read +0.04, -0.02, (0), +2.04 and RATE +63; FIN's smoother state is exactly at its new value right after each tap (0x7f000000 on, 0x40000000 off), and a FIN off rest keeps its value. The same cases on the 0.1.1 build (SO05, same session) failed each changed check: semitone steps, and FIN still gliding (0x770f…, 0x4a71…). Earlier versions: SP03 to SP13 and LF01, as reported by the author (TESTING.md).
limitations: 0.2.0's results are the rig's measurements on the unit (memory words and screens), not a person playing; nobody listened to the switch or the cents.
Not run on a unit for 0.2.0: pattern save and reload of TUN locks in cents (the fine lane is read in stock's code only), stock OS loading a sound saved with cents, NRPN, pads.
LOAD TO TRACK in SOUND MANAGER often gave ERROR on the unit (0.1.x), on sounds with nothing to do with RATE too, and the one load that worked came back with the setting clear; stock was not compared.
Not tested on a unit: two voices together, performance and scene locks by ear, CPU load alone.
Image SF08 contains the author's private rig base (the USB test link); the library build uses the published base, not run on the unit.

tests.summary: rytm-emu on OS 1.74: the switch keeps 1x through both taps (loop period 0.4954 s; 0.1.1 lost 25 ms and gained 13 ms), TUN turns in cents, pressed in semitones; rig cases pass on SF06 and fail on 0.1.1 where behaviour changed. Unit (0.2.0, rig): SF08 passes 6 cases twice in a row (SF06 three times); 0.1.1 fails them there too. Earlier, as reported by the author: SP03 to SP13, LF01 (TESTING.md).
